name: Text
description:
The Text component renders typography with Panda style props such as
`textStyle` and `color`. Choose the element with `as` (`p` by default,
`h1`–`h6`, `strong`, `em`, `small` or `span`); it accepts every
HTML attribute of that element, `ref` included.

**NOTE**: This API is _slotless_ and has no recipe: nothing is styled until you
pass style props.

parts.name: El
parts.description: Renders the element chosen with `as` (`p` by default, `h1`–`h6`, `strong`, `em`, `small`, `span`) with style props

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render as. Defaults to 'p'.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the Text component.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.
